plan.bias: bullish — buy-side setups across all three indices after strong positive momentum
plan.summary: After strong continued positive momentum in NIFTY and SENSEX (BANKNIFTY laggy with a small rejection), the teacher is firmly bullish and plans to identify buying-side (CE) setups in flat-to-gap-up opens on all three indices. He expects no gap-down after such positive charts, but says if one occurs it would likely trap sellers, so his plan stays the same — look to buy. No downside/target plan is given for the existing buyers; levels are the marked supports and resistances per index.
